name: agent-ready-content
description: Serve HTML to humans and markdown to agents from the same URLs. Sanity Studio + Next.js + Astro monorepo with content negotiation, sitemap.md, and llms.txt.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n studio,next,astro -c '#f03e2f,#8b5cf6,#f5a623' 'pnpm --filter studio dev' 'pnpm --filter next-app dev' 'pnpm --filter astro-app dev'
scripts.seed: pnpm --filter studio exec sanity dataset import ../seed/seed.ndjson production --replace
